# Beauty Configurator

> A beauty-look configurator demo: pick one of six pre-styled looks, customise base, eyes, lips and cheeks option by option, and bring the resulting card to the studio. Available in English and Italian.

This is a demonstration project showcasing an interactive product-configurator UX pattern for beauty studios. The studio name, address and contact email shown in the app are placeholders, not a real business.

## Pages

- [Home](https://beauty-configurator.vercel.app/): the six available looks and their starting prices.
- [Natural Glow](https://beauty-configurator.vercel.app/configure/natural-glow): configure the Natural Glow look.
- [Evening Drama](https://beauty-configurator.vercel.app/configure/evening-drama): configure the Evening Drama look.
- [Soft Rose](https://beauty-configurator.vercel.app/configure/soft-rose): configure the Soft Rose look.
- [Golden Hour](https://beauty-configurator.vercel.app/configure/golden-hour): configure the Golden Hour look.
- [Urban Cool](https://beauty-configurator.vercel.app/configure/urban-cool): configure the Urban Cool look.
- [Bridal Glow](https://beauty-configurator.vercel.app/configure/bridal-glow): configure the Bridal Glow look.

Each page above is also available in Italian under an `/it` prefix, e.g. https://beauty-configurator.vercel.app/it/configure/natural-glow.
